_delegated: v2 (atomicExitFor). Every field below is immutable at construction.
_priceFeeds: Chainlink AggregatorV3 feed per swappable asset. The delegated slippage floor is priced off THESE, not off aaveOracle, because getAssetPrice() carries no timestamp. An asset with a swap route but no feed reverts MissingPriceFeed on the delegated path (the self-serve path is unaffected). Testnet demo assets listed in mockOracleAssets keep the mock-oracle escape hatch instead.
_oracleStalenessSeconds: Max age of a feed answer, in seconds. Deploy script accepts 60-86400; set it to the feed's heartbeat plus a margin.
_sequencerUptimeFeed: Chainlink L2 sequencer-uptime feed. Base mainnet: 0xBCF85224fc0756B9Fa45aA7892530B47e10b6433. Base Sepolia does not publish one - leave it as the zero address there, which SKIPS the check.
_sequencerGracePeriodSeconds: Cooldown after the sequencer comes back before delegated exits resume (queued orders land first and move the price).
_maxPermitSlippageBps: Ceiling on ExitPermit.maxSlippageBps. Deploy script accepts 1-2000; past 20% it stops being slippage tolerance.
_delegatedMarkets: Moonwell mTokens and Comet instances a permit may name. The executor calls these with permit-supplied calldata and approves tokens to them, so an unregistered address is a theft vector - only what is listed here is reachable. Aave and Morpho need no entries.
